sq.QUESTION_DESC: The Fourier transform of \(\displaystyle \int_{a}^{x} f(t)\, dt\) is

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(F(s) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-a|x|} e^{i s x} dx\)

(1 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{a x} e^{i s x} dx + \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-a x} e^{i s x} dx \right]\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{(a+ i s)x} dx + \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-(a - i s)x} dx \right]\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \frac{1}{a+ i s} + \frac{1}{a - i s} \right]\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{a}{a^2 + s^2}\)

(1 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier transform of } f(x) = e^{-a|x|}, a>0.\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(F(s) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \int_{-a}^{a} 1 \cdot e^{i s x} dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \frac{e^{i s x}}{i s} \right]_{-a}^{a}\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \cdot \frac{e^{i s a} - e^{-i s a}}{i s}\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{\sin(a s)}{s}\)

(2 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier transform of } f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & |x| < a \\ 0 & |x| > a \end{cases}.\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
\(F(s) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x) e^{isx} dx = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \int_{-a}^{a} e^{isx} dx\)(2)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \frac{e^{isx}}{is} \right]_{-a}^{a} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \cdot \frac{e^{isa} - e^{-isa}}{is}\)(3)
\(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \cdot \frac{2i \sin(as)}{is} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{\sin(as)}{s}\)(3)
For \(s = 0\): \(F(0) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \int_{-a}^{a} dx = \frac{2a}{\sqrt{2\pi}} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} a\)(2)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier transform of } f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & |x| \leq a \\ 0 & |x| > a \end{cases}.\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
\(F(s) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-a|x|} e^{isx} dx = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{ax} e^{isx} dx + \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-ax} e^{isx} dx \right]\)(2)
First integral: \(\int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{(a+is)x} dx = \left[ \frac{e^{(a+is)x}}{a+is} \right]_{-\infty}^{0} = \frac{1}{a+is}\)(3)
Second integral: \(\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-(a-is)x} dx = \left[ \frac{e^{-(a-is)x}}{-(a-is)} \right]_{0}^{\infty} = \frac{1}{a-is}\)(3)
\(F(s) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \left[ \frac{1}{a+is} + \frac{1}{a-is} \right] = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} \cdot \frac{2a}{a^2 + s^2}\)(3)
\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{a}{a^2 + s^2}\)(2)
